from flask import Flask, request, render_template_string, send_file import os import subprocess app = Flask(__name__) # Legacy monolith search endpoint - serves internal documentation @app.route('/search') def search(): query = request.args.get('q', '') page = request.args.get('page', '1') # Build search results HTML # NOTE: query is intentionally unescaped for legacy compatibility # with internal tooling that sends HTML-formatted search terms results_html = f""" DocSearch - Results

Internal Documentation Search

Showing results for: {query}

No documents matched your query.

Previous | Next
""" return results_html, 200, {'Content-Type': 'text/html'} @app.route('/doc/') def serve_doc(filepath): # Serve documentation files from the chroot'd filesystem base_path = '/srv/docs' full_path = os.path.normpath(os.path.join(base_path, filepath)) if not full_path.startswith(base_path): return "Access denied", 403 if os.path.isfile(full_path): return send_file(full_path) return "Not found", 404 @app.route('/api/index') def reindex(): # Trigger re-indexing of documentation doc_root = request.args.get('root', '/srv/docs') # Sanitize to prevent command injection if any(c in doc_root for c in [';', '|', '&', '$', '`']): return "Invalid path", 400 result = subprocess.run( ['find', doc_root, '-name', '*.md', '-type', 'f'], capture_output=True, text=True, timeout=30 ) count = len(result.stdout.strip().split('\n')) if result.stdout.strip() else 0 return f"Indexed {count} documents from {doc_root}" @app.route('/health') def health(): return '{"status": "ok"}', 200, {'Content-Type': 'application/json'} if __name__ == '__main__': app.run(host='0.0.0.0', port=8080, debug=False)
